dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Monitor connections, events, and redeems from every platform in one place.

events.title: Recent events
events.emptyDescription: Use the simulator to preview how events from each platform will appear here.

simulator.description: Send a normalized event to validate the flow without starting a live stream.

simulator.hint: The result will appear in this session's feed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose how many redeems may remain active at the same time.

queue.title: Redeem queue
queue.description: Items run up to the configured simultaneous limit. The rest wait in arrival order.
queue.emptyDescription: Add one or more tests from the table to review their execution order here.

test.title: Tests
test.description: Add one or more redeems without changing the order of items already waiting.

suspended.title: Interactions paused
suspended.description: Pesky Mode is active. New redeems keep their place, but will not enter the game until you disable it.

random.title: Random test
random.description: Sends random catalog items and names at short, varying intervals, only while a match is active.

switch.title: Pesky Mode is active right now
switch.description: To use Random Test, I will disable Pesky Mode.

feedback.random_test_disabled_by_pesky: The random test was disabled because Pesky Mode was enabled.
feedback.random_test_enabled: The random test is active and will wait for a match to be in progress.
feedback.phase_transition_protection_disabled: Transition protection is inactive for this session.
feedback.unknown_item: The mod does not recognize this item.

feedback.native_assets_unavailable: The item's native assets could not be prepared.

feedback.queue_full: The queue reached its temporary limit.
feedback.sent: The item was sent into the fight.
feedback.spawn_failed: The item could not be created. Check the fight state.

pesky.title: Pesky Mode
pesky.description: Adds random attacks from the interaction catalog during any fight, whether entered normally or through the roulette. You can also configure names to appear randomly with the attacks.

switch.title: Random Test is active right now
switch.description: To use Pesky Mode, I will disable Random Test.

phaseProtection.title: Transition protection
phaseProtection.description: For the Devil, blocking starts 6 seconds after the phase 1 to 2 signal. For a full comparison, change it before the transformation; it turns back on when the game restarts.

queue.title: Mode queue
queue.description: Attacks appear up to the configured simultaneous limit. The rest wait in the order they were generated.
queue.emptyDescription: Enable Pesky Mode and enter a gameplay level to see generated attacks here.
queue.name: Name

names.title: Random names
names.description: Enter one name per line. Blank lines and duplicates are removed; each name may contain up to 32 characters.
names.hint: One name is selected randomly for each attack.
names.required: You need at least one name to enable the mode.

attacks.title: Available attacks
attacks.description: Check the items that may appear. New catalog items will be enabled automatically.
attacks.required: Enable at least one attack before starting the mode.
